description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%), representing the accuracy of various models. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 0 to 10^3, and tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot displays six lines, each representing a different model: Base (black, circle marker, solid line), FT (blue, triangle marker, solid line), IKE (red, triangle marker, solid line), MEND (brown, diamond marker, solid line), MEMIT (purple, circle marker, solid line), and ROME (green, square marker, solid line). The Base line starts at approximately 63% at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increases to around 71% at 2*10^3. The FT line begins at about 65% and rises to roughly 74% over the same range. The IKE line starts at approximately 67% and reaches around 76%. The MEND line begins at about 70% and increases to roughly 81%. The MEMIT line starts at approximately 69% and rises to around 79%. The ROME line begins at about 74% and reaches around 86% at a Co-occurrence Number of 2*10^3. All lines exhibit a steady upward trend as the Co-occurrence Number increases.
